description: This file defines a utility object 'ImageCacheUtils' for managing image request cancellations tied to ImageView instances in an Android app. It provides a method to cancel ongoing image loading requests, helping to prevent reuse artifacts when views are rebound.

classes.name: ImageCacheUtils
classes.description: A utility singleton object providing a method to cancel ongoing image requests associated with an ImageView.

methods.name: cancelOngoingRequest
methods.description: Cancels any ongoing image request for the given ImageView by invoking the image loader’s dispose method. Uses Coil library to manage image requests and handles potential exceptions silently.
